sources.text: Main text decoder only. The analytical profile uses the pinned Transformers full-attention sigmoid output gate in both releases, including Qwen3.8 whose config declares swish. Vision, MTP, training, runtime allocator and framework kernel execution are outside this scope.

Gated DeltaNet prefill and decode both use the serial recurrent equations for mathematical work. It is an authored idealized state-update/liveness ledger, not the chunk kernel, its scratch space, or an exact PyTorch allocation trace.

BF16 weights, activations, GQA KV and convolution history; FP32 recurrent matrices and explicit FP32 workspace. Norm, nonlinear, comparison and mask work use scalar proxies; casts, index routing implementation, rotary table creation and kernel-specific copies are excluded. Routed traffic uses the upper bound on distinct experts touched.

GQA assigns each rank matching query groups and whole KV heads. DeltaNet splits the Q, K and V convolution channels independently, associates each key head with its value heads, and partitions the FP32 recurrent matrix on the value-head axis. Each attention output projection contributes a partial hidden tile to the residual AllReduce.

Routed expert TP splits J within every expert. Gate and up retain their paired feature slices; every rank receives the same selected expert IDs and normalized weights, and contributes a partial weighted output. The partial routed output is reduced before the replicated shared expert is added. Routing comparisons use a scalar FP32 vector work proxy.
